description: MHA + slope=0.3 + MLP_MULT=3.5 (MLP params traded for MHA KV params; main candidate)
comment: steps=4821 tok/s=6380376. **Main candidate. First cap-legal MHA point**: 15,910,585 bytes (89,415 headroom). Size-prediction model worked: empirical bytes/param=0.422 from Stage 4 MHA (+1,217,830 bytes / +2,883,584 params); predicted MHA_M35 ≈ S03 size (15,950,029) since MLP_MULT 4.0->3.5 removes exactly the same 2,883,584 params MHA adds to kv_bank; actual 15,910,585 = predicted -39,444 bytes (better packing of LQER factors). **However ttt_bpb 1.06513 vs Stage 4 MHA 1.05725 = +0.00788 BPB regression** — the unconstrained MHA win was bought entirely by the extra MLP capacity, not by the MHA capability itself. Net vs Stage 4 S03 (slope=0.3, kv=4, M40, ttt=1.06139): +0.00374 BPB at -39,444 bytes. **MHA_M35 is NOT better than S03 on a fixed budget**; the trade is "lose ~0.0037 BPB to gain MHA architectural property + 39 KB headroom". Throughput -3.1% vs S03 (6.38M vs 6.59M tok/s).

description: MHA + slope=0.3 + NUM_LAYERS=10 + XSA_LAST_N=10 (drop one block; depth-vs-width control)
comment: steps=5179 tok/s=6837587. **Best raw MHA cell on cap**: ttt_bpb 1.06352 vs S03 1.06139 = +0.00213 (smaller penalty than MHA_M35's +0.00374). bytes 15,806,169 = 193,831 headroom (more than M35's 89 KB). Size-prediction model: predicted -262,144 params vs S03 → ~15,839,317 bytes; actual 15,806,169 = predicted -33,148 bytes (consistent ~30 KB compression noise). **Throughput +3.8% vs M35** (6.84M vs 6.38M tok/s) — fewer total layers compensates for MHA's K/V bandwidth doubling. **At 1.0x batch L=10 trains 358 more steps in 600s**, partly explaining the BPB win over M35. Direct depth-vs-width comparison: L=10 wins by 0.00161 BPB at 105 KB more headroom, 7% more throughput. Layer depth has more BPB headroom than MLP width inside the cap.

description: MHA + slope=0.3 + MLP_MULT=3.5 + Stage 1/2 free wins (LQER_TOP_K=1 GATED_ATTN_QUANT_GATE=1 TTT_BATCH_SIZE=16)
comment: steps=4945 tok/s=6586427. **Stage 1/2 free wins stack on top of MHA_M35 cleanly**: ttt_bpb 1.06236 vs MHA_M35 1.06513 = -0.00277, bytes +296 (essentially same artifact). Decomposition vs MHA_M35: pre_quant -0.00220, quant -0.00240, ttt -0.00277. The three free wins (A5+C2+R1 from Stage 1+2 §9.1) deliver the predicted -0.00080 each, summing close to the expected -0.00081 (Stage 1+2 expected -0.00081 over Z0 baseline, actual -0.00277 over MHA baseline because of multiplicative interaction with the changed activation budget). **Still worse than S03 (1.06139)**: net +0.00097 BPB vs S03 at +296 bytes. **But best MHA-shaped submission-legal point** so far: 89,119 bytes headroom + +0.00097 BPB regression, vs unconstrained MHA's +1,167,859 bytes overage. Throughput parity with non-BEST cells (6.59M ~ S03's 6.59M, no measurable cost from the three knobs).

description: MHA + slope=0.3 + NUM_LAYERS=10 + XSA_LAST_N=10 + PARALLEL_START_LAYER=7 (L10 architecture control)
comment: steps=5173 tok/s=6827199. **Marginal improvement over MHA_L10** by moving parallel-lane start one layer earlier (8→7) so L=10 keeps similar parallel-depth coverage as L=11 baseline. ttt_bpb 1.06305 vs MHA_L10 1.06352 = -0.00047 BPB at +4,980 bytes (still 188,851 headroom). pre_quant and quant deltas (-0.00043, -0.00048) align with ttt → effect is real, not seed noise. Throughput parity with MHA_L10. **Best cap-legal MHA-shaped cell of the patch sweep**: ttt 1.06305 vs S03 1.06139 = +0.00166 BPB regression at +18,720 bytes vs S03 — i.e. trades ~0.0017 BPB for the MHA architectural property and 188 KB headroom. PARALLEL_START_LAYER=7 is a free architectural knob (no params change), only changes the encoder/decoder split point in the GPT.encoder_indices/decoder_indices construction.

steps=5021 tok/s=6589942. **Confirmed under-param**: ttt 1.06976 vs MHA_M35 1.06513 = +0.00463 BPB regression for an extra 1,249,239 bytes of size headroom. The MLP capacity drop from 1792 to 1536 hidden eats into the BPB hard. Size-prediction model: predicted -2,883,584 params vs S03 → ~14,732,199 bytes; actual 14,661,346 = predicted -70,853 bytes (~5% over-shrink, again consistent compression noise but slightly larger than M35/L10). Throughput parity with MHA_M35_BEST (6.59M tok/s). **Negative result: MLP_MULT 3.0 is too aggressive**; the MHA gain cannot be recovered when MLP is shrunk past 3.5. Useful as the lower bound of the headroom-vs-BPB Pareto curve and as confirmation that MLP capacity matters.

description: MHA + slope=0.3 + NUM_LAYERS=10 + XSA_LAST_N=10 + MLP_MULT=3.5 (combined over-shrink)
comment: steps=5291 tok/s=7049058. **Confirmed combined over-shrink**: ttt 1.06960 vs MHA_M30 1.06976 = -0.00017 (essentially same), bytes 14,668,530 vs M30 14,661,346 = +7,184 bytes. **The two compensations (L=10 + M=3.5) don't stack BPB-wise**: each individually gave back capacity; combined the model is too under-param to extract them. Size-prediction model: predicted -2,883,584 params vs S03 (same as M30 because the MLP and layer cuts compose at the param level here — L10*M35 ≈ L11*M30 in matrix-param-count). Throughput +7.0% vs MHA_L10_P7 (the best L10 cell) and +10.4% vs MHA_M35 — fewer layers + narrower MLP = highest steps/600s in the patch sweep at 5291 steps. Useful as throughput ceiling reference; not a candidate for submission.
